name: unbound
description_en: Unbound is a validating, recursive, and caching DNS resolver.
readme_excerpt: Unbound Unbound is a validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver. It is designed to be fast and lean and incorporates modern features based on open standards. If you have any feedback, we would love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to create an issue on Github or post a message on our community forum.
